question: If 'FESTIVE' is coded as '16113215011' and 'HUNGER' is coded as '1427815114', then how will 'GRUDGE' be coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/628ca7c384d26965e47ac16ebed41bae76f1d6522fad422493a16c7b3c4d3777.png] 

__**LOGIC**__: ** Code for consonants = Positional value of opposite letter - 5; code for vowel = Positional value + 6**

The Pattern followed here is:

 
• **Code for consonants = Positional value of opposite letter - 5;**
 
• **code for vowel = Positional value + 6**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93ed946334d4cb812f153f1bfd6d14dd4548d047ad8bacc8068f583ee55459a5.png] 

and,

 
• Code for consonants = Positional value of opposite letter - 5;
 
• code for vowel = Positional value + 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d851feef886e720ccc20eda3c2be7fd55fc8a1d6c8ffafb0e4a37a3bb738273.png] 

Similarly,

 
• Code for consonants = Positional value of opposite letter - 5;
 
• code for vowel = Positional value + 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dd7fcdbefabbf6d6ba342b5aa3113598f48b8c00a639d03bf353015561b9b23.png] 

Thus, GRUDGE is coded as "15427181511".

Hence, the correct answer is **"15427181511"**.
